summary: One unit in a set of unlike items the reader browses, or an object recognised by its image.
not_for: A record of a homogeneous set (a row or a table), or a section of the page (a heading on the ground).

rules.rule: At most two function buttons on a card.
A card that is a link as a whole holds no other link or control.
The content is what the reader needs to know first, short.
A card carries at least one property beside its title; a card of a title alone is a link.

evidence.source: デジタル庁デザインシステム, カード
evidence.says: A card is a container for one subject: an image area, a main area with the title, a label and content, and a sub area with links or up to two function buttons.

evidence.source: Nielsen Norman Group, Cards: UI-Component Definition
evidence.says: Cards suit heterogeneous browsed items and summarise content that links to its details; lists and tables suit scanning and comparison.
A card shows bite-sized content, what people need to know first.
A clickable tile has a single action and no other interactive elements.
